name: computer_watch_start
description: Start a turn-scoped, in-memory observation of one explicit app window. Returns initial screenshot and semantic AX baseline without actionable element IDs. Replaces this turn's prior subscription. Uses a native window capture stream when supported, otherwise bounded polling at the stated interval, coalesces changes, and expires after 60s without a consumer. Stop when finished. Query/observe separately before any input.

name: computer_watch_next
description: Wait for a window change since after_sequence. Returns changed=false on timeout; changed updates include an AX line splice or reset baseline and PNG only if pixels changed. Coalesced/skipped sequences are explicitly reported. Subscription snapshots never authorize input; use fresh computer_query/screenshot for actions. Failures stop the subscription and never replay input.

name: computer_watch_stop
description: Stop the current chat/turn window subscription and cancel capture. All subscriptions also close on turn/session end. Does not grant or alter system permissions.

name: computer_app_policy
description: Read AIClaw-maintained application-specific operating guidance and background capability limits for an exact app identifier. Built-in macOS Finder/Safari/TextEdit/Chrome/Edge/VSCode/WeCom strategies require exact bundle identifiers; PID-only Windows/Linux targets and other apps use generic guidance. Reports backend-specific semantic/background limits without granting extra capability. This is guidance, not permission or proof that a UI control exists. Does not launch an app or create an actionable observation.
